method: Fanned four parallel general-purpose research agents (WebSearch/WebFetch, read-only, no-nesting), one per target class. Each was required to cite a live-fetched URL for every claim and explicitly distinguish a confirmed absence from a read-path failure (403/404/DNS). Synthesized their reports into the inventory markdown; did not independently re-fetch every URL, but spot-checked the shape of each agent's evidence (live feature counts, verbatim license quotes, explicit disclosure of unverified secondary-source claims) for internal consistency before accepting it into the inventory.

agentSummaries.schoolDistrict: 108 tool uses across two agents worth of work folded into one (school-districts agent alone: 51 tool uses). Found TEA/TLC 'School Districts 2025' (1,017 features, live REST + direct download, DISTRICT county-district code as an attribute join candidate) cross-checked against NCES EDGE (1,018 features, independent count). Strong, statewide, ready to card.
agentSummaries.utilityService: 36 tool uses. Water/sewer: PUCT CCN polygons confirmed via three independent live mirrors (TWDB, Harris County GIS, Esri Hub) despite the primary PUCT page itself being blocked to the fetcher (HTTP 402, explicitly flagged as a fetcher-side block, not evidence of non-existence). Electric: all six counties confirmed inside ERCOT; no PUCT-native GIS layer found, best candidate is a federal HIFLD dataset whose REST endpoint could not be verified live (DNS failure, disclosed explicitly). Gas: confirmed structural absence -- Texas gas distribution is franchise-based, not certificated-territory-based, so no polygon layer exists to acquire.
agentSummaries.overlayDistricts: 101 tool uses. Checked all 18 in-scope cities; 12 have a real, distinct, fetchable overlay/historic-district layer (Austin richest by breadth, Georgetown richest single-city schema, San Marcos and Buda also strong). 6 unconfirmed or negative (Leander is a clean confirmed negative; Lockhart/Robinson/Elgin/Dripping Springs/Liberty Hill are open items needing a follow-up pass, not final negatives).
agentSummaries.agValuationImperviousTree: 67 tool uses. agValuation: one strong hit (Williamson CAD Socrata API, live-sampled agflag+statecode fields), rest unconfirmed/gated. maxImperviousCoverPct: Austin watershed-zone classification and the Edwards Aquifer recharge zone are both real and acquirable, but neither carries the percent-limit number itself -- that lives in ordinance text. treeProtection: Austin's heritage-tree permit log is real but is an event log, not a parcel census; explicitly flagged that absence in it is not evidence of absence of a protected tree.

citationSpotCheck.method: Verified structural consistency rather than re-fetching all ~30+ cited URLs independently: checked that live feature counts were reported as actually-queried numbers (not estimates) where claimed, that every 'not found' claim named whether it was a confirmed absence or a read-path failure, and that verbatim license quotes were marked as quotes rather than paraphrase.
citationSpotCheck.result: No fabricated-looking URL or unsupported claim found. Two items flagged by the agents themselves as lower-confidence and preserved as such in the inventory: the HIFLD electric REST endpoint (unverified live, DNS failure) and its field list (from secondary search-result description, not independently fetched).
